description:
Superseded 2026-10-08 by T-041 at Michael's direction. He restated the concept as graph locations forming the spine of a generative IF adventure, and asked for the Wolf Hall projection to be built rather than the Dracula paper playtest run. The graph-to-game adapter now exists as adventure/projection.py + explore.py + narrator.py, so Gate 0 below no longer blocks construction. Status left in progress for Michael to close or repurpose; no reader sessions were run.

Revised after second review. Gate 0 now requires three unfamiliar-reader sessions: at least one unsolicited new intent answered by unselected YAML evidence, at least one independent blood-memory hypothesis before disclosure, and a DO/LOOK direction in two readers with >=4 eligible commands each. Defined proceed/revise/stop rules and blank turn log; Michael/assistant rehearsals cannot pass discovery gate. Paper pilot has two selectable interview leads (nun/fly versus bag/Agatha intentions), a crucifix coverage dead end, consistent second-person prose and no advertised manuscript interaction. 23 exact source values (original 18 plus five), all pointers/hashes verified. Removed active adapter sketch. Numbered upstream candidates UP-007 fan-out, UP-008 collapsed kit identity, UP-009 fused recollection/interview with Agatha participation and false flashback flag; added exact diagnostic values/hashes. Current graph ownership still unverified; prior explicit dracula.s01 properties(r) attempt failed DatabaseNotFound, no fresh Neo4j/TNG operations. Retained source/derived-text separation, scope, snippets, revision404 and undirected BFS findings. Pending real reader evidence and source verification before adapter construction; runtime unchanged.
title: Design a graph-grounded exploration adapter
